ei.title: When Loss Becomes Joy: A Change in View
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, took a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave destroyed Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears streamed down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, saying she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!

questions.passage: Marilyn and her three-year-old daughter, Sarah, ①<u>took</u> a trip to the beach, where Sarah built her first sandcastle. Moments later, an enormous wave ②<u>destroyed</u> Sarah's castle. In response to the loss of her sandcastle, tears ③<u>streamed</u> down Sarah's cheeks and her heart was broken. She ran to Marilyn, ④<u>said</u> she would never build a sandcastle again. Marilyn said, "Part of the joy of building a sandcastle is that, in the end, we give it as a gift to the ocean." Sarah loved this idea and responded with enthusiasm to the idea of building another castle—this time, even closer to the water so the ocean would get its gift sooner!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ said → saying: 주절(ran)과 동시동작을 나타내는 분사구문이므로 현재분사가 필요
det.analysis:
❌ ① took: 'took a trip to the beach'에서 과거시제 — 적절

❌ ② destroyed: 'an enormous wave destroyed'에서 과거시제 — 적절

❌ ③ streamed: 'tears streamed down'에서 과거시제 — 적절

✅ ④ said → saying: 'She ran to Marilyn, saying...'에서 주절 ran과 동시에 일어나는 동작을 나타내는 분사구문이므로 현재분사 saying이 필요. said(과거)는 본동사 ran이 이미 있어 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: 분사구문(동시동작): ran, saying(말하며)

det.korean: ① build → built: 주절이 과거(took)이므로 관계부사절도 과거시제가 필요
det.analysis:

❌ ② broken: 'her heart was broken'에서 수동태의 과거분사 — 적절

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

❌ ② 바다 근처에서 노는 위험(the dangers of playing near the ocean): 본문과 무관

✅ ③ 상실을 기쁨으로 바꾼 어머니의 지혜(a mother's wisdom turning loss into joy): 상실 → 재해석 → 긍정적 수용의 흐름과 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ 파도가 생기는 과학적 이유(the scientific reason why ocean waves form): 본문의 핵심이 아님
det.tip: wisdom turning loss into joy = 상실을 기쁨으로 바꾼 지혜

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 we give it as a gift to the ocean이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 상실을 아쉬워하는 대신 모래성을 바다에게 기꺼이 내어 주는 기쁜 나눔으로 재해석한다는 뜻
det.analysis:
✅ ① 기꺼이 놓아주고 기쁜 것으로서 바다와 나눔(we willingly let it go and share it with the sea as something joyful): 파도에 무너진 모래성을 상실이 아니라 바다에게 주는 선물로 재해석하는 긍정적 의미 ←정답

❌ ② 일부러 깊은 바다에 던진다(throw it into the deep sea on purpose): 실제로 던지는 행위가 아닌 비유적 재해석

❌ ③ 진짜 선물을 사서 부친다(buy a real present and mail it): 물리적 선물이 아님

❌ ④ 파도로부터 지키려고 성을 쌓는다(build a castle only to protect it): 지키는 것이 아니라 내어 주는 것
det.tip: give it as a gift to the ocean = 상실을 기쁜 나눔으로 재해석

ch: we willingly let it go and share it with the sea as something joyful
we throw the sandcastle into the deep sea on purpose
we buy a real present and mail it to someone far away
we build a castle only to protect it from the waves
